text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no known antidote for Fondaparinux Sodium Solution. Overdose of Fondaparinux Sodium Solution may lead to hemorrhagic complications. Discontinue treatment and initiate appropriate therapy if bleeding complications associated with overdosage occur. Data obtained in patients undergoing chronic intermittent hemodialysis suggest that clearance of Fondaparinux Sodium Solution can increase by 20% during hemodialysis.
